200: apparently from the same as ἄκρον; a locust (as pointed, or as lighting on the top of vegetation):--locust.
201: from ἀκροατής; an audience-room:--place of hearing.
202: from (to listen; apparently an intensive of ἀκούω); a hearer (merely):--hearer.
203: from ἄκρον and probably a modified form of (the penis or male sexual organ); the prepuce; by implication, an uncircumcised (i.e. gentile, figuratively, unregenerate) state or person:--not circumcised, uncircumcised (with ἔχω), uncircumcision.
204: from ἄκρον and γωνία; belonging to the extreme corner:--chief corner.
205: from ἄκρον and (a heap); properly (in the plural) the top of the heap, i.e. (by implication) best of the booty:--spoils.
206: neuter of an adjective probably akin to the base of ἀκμήν; the extremity:--one end… other, tip, top, uttermost participle
207: probably for Latin aquila (an eagle); Akulas, an Israelite:--Aquila.
208: from Α (as a negative particle) and κυρόω; to invalidate:--disannul, make of none effect.
209: adverb from a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of κωλύω; in an unhindered manner, i.e. freely:--no man forbidding him.
210: from Α (as a negative particle) and ἑκών; unwilling:--against the will.
211: neuter of (of uncertain derivation), the name of a stone; properly, an "alabaster" box, i.e. (by extension) a perfume vase (of any material):--(alabaster) box.
212: from ἀλαζών; braggadocio, i.e. (by implication) self-confidence:--boasting, pride.
214: from ( a shout, "halloo"); to vociferate, i.e. (by implication) to wail; figuratively, to clang:--tinkle, wail.
215: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of λαλέω; unspeakable:--unutterable, which cannot be uttered.
216: from Α (as a negative particle) and λαλέω; mute:--dumb.
218: from Α (as particle of union) and the base of λιπαρός; to oil (with perfume):--anoint.
219: from ἀλέκτωρ and φωνή; cock-crow, i.e. the third night-watch:--cockcrowing.
220: from (to ward off); a cock or male fowl:--cock.
221: from (the city so called); an Alexandreian or inhabitant of Alexandria:--of Alexandria, Alexandrian.
222: from the same as Ἀλεξανδρεύς; Alexandrine, or belonging to Alexandria:--of Alexandria.
223: from the same as (the first part of) ἀλέκτωρ and ἀνήρ; man-defender; Alexander, the name of three Israelites and one other man:--Alexander.
225: from ἀληθής; truth:--true, X truly, truth, verity.
226: from ἀληθής; to be true (in doctrine and profession):--speak (tell) the truth.
227: from Α (as a negative particle) and λανθάνω; true (as not concealing):--true, truly, truth.
229: from the same as ἄλευρον; to grind:--grind.
230: adverb from ἀληθής; truly:--indeed, surely, of a surety, truly, of a (in) truth, verily, very.
231: from ἅλς; a sailor (as engaged on the salt water), i.e. (by implication) a fisher:--fisher(-man).
232: from ἁλιεύς; to be a fisher, i.e. (by implication) to fish:--go a-fishing.
235: neuter plural of ἄλλος; properly, other things, i.e. (adverbially) contrariwise (in many relations):--and, but (even), howbeit, indeed, nay, nevertheless, no, notwithstanding, save, therefore, yea, yet.
237: from ἄλλος; from elsewhere:--some other way.
238: from ἄλλος and (to harangue (compare ἀγορά)); to allegorize:--be an allegory (the Greek word itself).
239: of Hebrew origin (imperative of הָלַל and יָהּ); praise ye Jah!, an adoring exclamation:--alleluiah.
240: Genitive plural from ἄλλος reduplicated; one another:--each other, mutual, one another, (the other), (them-, your-)selves, (selves) together (sometimes with μετά or πρός).
241: from ἄλλος and γένος; foreign, i.e. not a Jew:--stranger.
242: middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to jump; figuratively, to gush:--leap, spring up.
243: a primary word; "else," i.e. different (in many applications):--more, one (another), (an-, some an-)other(-s, -wise).
244: from ἀλλότριος and ἐπίσκοπος; overseeing others' affairs, i.e. a meddler (specially, in Gentile customs):--busybody in other men's matters.
245: from ἄλλος; another's, i.e. not one's own; by extension foreign, not akin, hostile:--alien, (an-)other (man's, men's), strange(-r).
246: from ἄλλος and φυλή; foreign, i.e. (specially) Gentile:--one of another nation.
248: from the same as ἅλων; to tread out grain:--thresh, tread out the corn.
249: from Α (as a negative particle) and λόγος; irrational:--brute, unreasonable.
250: of foreign origin (compare ἀκάνθινος); aloes (the gum):--aloes.
253: comparative of a compound of Α (as a negative particle) and λύπη; more without grief:--less sorrowful.
254: of uncertain derivation; a fetter or manacle:--bonds, chain.
255: from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of λυσιτελεῖ; gainless, i.e. (by implication) pernicious:--unprofitable.
256: of Hebrew origin (compare חֶלֶף); Alphæus, an Israelite:--Alpheus.
257: probably from the base of εἱλίσσω; a threshing-floor (as rolled hard), i.e. (figuratively) the grain (and chaff, as just threshed):--floor.
258: of uncertain derivation; a fox, i.e. (figuratively) a cunning person:--fox.
259: from a collateral form of αἱρέομαι; capture, be taken.
260: a primary particle; properly, at the "same" time, but freely used as a preposition or adverb denoting close association:--also, and, together, with(-al).
261: from Α (as a negative particle) and μανθάνω; ignorant:--unlearned.
262: from ἀμάραντος; "amaranthine", i.e. (by implication) fadeless:--that fadeth not away.
263: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μαραίνω; unfading, i.e. (by implication) perpetual:--that fadeth not away.
264: perhaps from Α (as a negative particle) and the base of μέρος; properly, to miss the mark (and so not share in the prize), i.e. (figuratively) to err, especially (morally) to sin:--for your faults, offend, sin, trespass.
266: from ἁμαρτάνω; a sin (properly abstract):--offence, sin(-ful).
267: from Α (as a negative particle) and a form of μάρτυς; unattested:--without witness.
268: from ἁμαρτάνω; sinful, i.e. a sinner:--sinful, sinner.
269: from Α (as a negative particle) and μάχη; peaceable:--not a brawler.
270: from ἅμα; properly, to collect, i.e. (by implication) reap:--reap down.
271: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μεθύω; the "amethyst" (supposed to prevent intoxication):--amethyst.
272: from Α (as a negative particle) and μέλω; to be careless of:--make light of, neglect, be negligent, no regard.
273: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μέμφομαι; irreproachable:--blameless, faultless, unblamable.
275: from Α (as a negative particle) and μέριμνα; not anxious:--without care(-fulness), secure.
276: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μετατίθημι; unchangeable, or (neuter as abstract) unchangeability:--immutable(-ility).
277: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μετακινέω; immovable:--unmovable.
278: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μεταμέλλομαι; irrevocable:--without repentance, not to be repented of.
279: from Α (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of μετανοέω; unrepentant:--impenitent.
280: from Α (as a negative particle) and μέτρον; immoderate:--(thing) without measure.
281: of Hebrew origin (אָמֵן); properly, firm, i.e. (figuratively) trustworthy; adverbially, surely (often as interjection, so be it):--amen, verily.
282: from Α (as a negative particle) and μήτηρ; motherless, i.e. of unknown maternity:--without mother.
283: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μιαίνω; unsoiled, i.e. (figuratively) pure:--undefiled.
284: of Hebrew origin (עַמִּינָדָב); Aminadab, an Israelite:--Aminadab.
285: perhaps from ἅμα; sand (as heaped on the beach):--sand.
286: apparently a primary word; a lamb:--lamb.
288: probably from the base of ἀμφότερος and that of ἅλων; a vine (as coiling about a support):--vine.
289: from ἄμπελος and ἔργον; a vine-worker, i.e. pruner:--vine-dresser.
291: contracted for Latin ampliatus (enlarged); Amplias, a Roman Christian:--Amplias.
292: middle voice of a primary verb; to ward off (for oneself), i.e. protect:--defend.
293: from a compound of the base of ἀμφότερος and βάλλω; a (fishing) net (as thrown about the fish):--net.
294: from the base of ἀμφότερος and (to invest); to enrobe:--clothe.
295: from the base of ἀμφότερος and πόλις; a city surrounded by a river; Amphipolis, a place in Macedonia:--Amphipolis.
296: from the base of ἀμφότερος and ὁδός; a fork in the road:--where two ways meet.
298: from Α (as a negative particle) and a derivative of μωμάομαι; unblamable:--blameless.
299: from Α (as a negative particle) and μῶμος; unblemished (literally or figuratively):--without blame (blemish, fault, spot), faultless, unblamable.
